See [4-4 AlphaGo Joseki](https://online-go.com/puzzle/8671)

White can highlight Black's thinness by playing around <C:Q10>, or at **1** with the aim of peeping at <B:P15>.

For an easy-to-understand example of how to pressure Black's wall, see [Michael Redmond, *AlphaGo vs. The World: Game 23, Kim Junghyun 6p (W) vs. AlphaGo Master (B)*](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=H8Oehpm4Rho&t=518s).
